title: Benchmarking Generation and Evaluation Capabilities of Large Language Models for Instruction Controllable Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating correlations between summary length and LLM evaluator scores, comparing LLM evaluator preferences against a "length oracle" that always prefers longer summaries, and analyzing win rates of longer versus shorter summaries.
Randomly shuffling the order of candidate summaries in pairwise comparison prompts to detect and mitigate preference for the first or second position.
